title: release: a failed prepush --list-frozen reads as no frozen remotes, so the frozen-remote gate passes unchecked
body:
The release pre-flight reads the frozen remotes with `$("$PROJECT_ROOT/bin/int" prepush --list-frozen 2>/dev/null || true)` (`bin/.devbin/cmd/build.d/release:534`). A listing that fails for any reason reads as "no frozen remotes", so the frozen-remote gate passes unchecked, and the release then pushes to both remotes.

Fix: capture the listing's exit status and abort when it fails (IN-AG-NO-SILENT-001). XS. vc's next-line list, item 5.


CLOSED 2026-09-19, by its landing in dc's train B on vc's word (bank 4999b625c, patch-id f697f38c25c4, judged green on the train's bats log refs/bank/dc/trainB/bats.log: every arm green on the fixed script and the new arm red on the unfixed one).
